summary: Global Tech Industries Group (GTII) through its receivership estate filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing a Note Assignment Agreement with MSC Capital Advisors. The estate acquired two defaulted convertible promissory notes from AURI, Inc. with $125,000 aggregate principal, assigned to satisfy a $100,000 MSC Note debt. Conversion terms are at a 75% discount to market. The receiver exercised conversions on April 7-8, 2026, seeking 841M+ AURI shares at $0.00005/share. This is part of GTII's court-supervised receivership, not a routine event. Watch for AURI's response and potential dilution disputes.
